title: Scenario cards: make the invoice add_line ask unambiguous, and read "reply yes and I'll delete" as pending_confirmation
body:
eval#1 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibzr7AespGQoymAnLtn

Filed by eval#1 (#33468) from the classification on #33973 (requested by repo:cloud#5 at the maintainer's order there).

Filing-gate category: ③ maintainer-directed (#33973: 「你用信箱和他沟通，需要的话你自己开云卡片跑评测」; acceptance "each class with at least two failures has a card filed").

## Why (business)

The write score is the number the cloud model choice rests on (#33920, #33924). 25 of its 121 failures in the 2026-11-15 runs are the card's own wording or reading, not the model: they cost every model the same and hide the real differences.

## What

1. `docs/qa/scenarios/invoice_with_line_items.json`, operation `add_line`: the ask "Add 2 Widgets to INV-003, 10 in total." reads three ways (10 items, 10 Widgets, amount 10). In 24 of 30 failures haiku and opus stopped to ask which; that is a correct answer to an ambiguous ask. Reword so the expected write is the only reading, for example "Add a line to INV-003: 2 Widgets, amount 10." (the card's `values` stay `quantity: 2, amount: 10`).
2. Grader: a reply that names the record, says nothing was deleted yet and asks for a go-ahead ("I need your go-ahead first … Reply yes and I'll …") is graded `refused (no write attempted)` instead of `pending_confirmation` (haiku default rep 3, iterate, `remove_ben`). Read an explicit request for a go-ahead before a destructive write as `pending_confirmation`.

## Acceptance

- `add_line`'s ask has one reading; a replay of the 2026-11-15 recordings is not the check (the ask changed), the next live round is.
- A unit test pins that reply shape as `pending_confirmation`.

## Not in scope

- Whether a delete the user asked for by name still needs a confirmation (76 of the 121): that is a rule question put to the maintainer first.
